translations.web: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn’t repent.
translations.bsb: Then Jesus began to denounce the cities in which most of His miracles had been performed, because they did not repent.
translations.kjv: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:
